review_text_raw:
What a game! I went into this with zero expectations and came out amazed. 

This game is incredibly written, the puzzles, the story, the characters. It is all genuinely incredible. The one thing I like about this game is that you feel immersed into the experience, it feels very real and you feel as if real lives are at stake. 

The cases are somewhat predictable, but not fully, there was times I was questioning myself and what to do. At some point I genuinely felt panic. It is very hard not to love this game, the sound design to the style of the game is amazing. 

I love being able to figure things out by myself and feel somewhat proud that I did it, although it doesn't have the most complicated puzzles, It is super satisfying when you put the pieces together. 

As for the ending, It felt a little rushed, I won't say any spoilers so don't worry, but the ending felt like this happened and then this. It felt all a little sudden, but I presume that's the point. 

While it is a short game, I would say it's worth the money, the graphics are nice and it runs super smooth. I have no complaints. I cannot wait to hear more news on the second game, I will be staying updated, because this my friends... Absolute cinema! 

I literally could not recommend this more, 9/10, point knocked off for being so short. I hope the second game contains more content.
